title: A recipient opens the unsubscribe link their newsletter carried and the withdrawal completes

backendBuild.detail: the in-repo fixture backend, not an API build (branch lane/fe-gr-exit-wire-the-mail)

steps.name: read the exit link out of the dispatched message body
steps.detail: captured link path /preferences/unsubscribe, fragment carries a 46-character u1. capability token

steps.name: open it in a browser, exactly as the recipient would
steps.detail: the done card rendered without any confirmation step

steps.name: the credential the browser spent is the one the dispatcher composed
steps.detail: the backend recorded exactly 1 withdrawal, and it was for the captured token

steps.name: the token is gone from the address bar
steps.detail: address bar reads /preferences/unsubscribe with no token

steps.name: a second click on the same link is still a done card, never a failure
steps.detail: replayed once more; still one recorded withdrawal, still the done card

steps.name: an expired or already-spent link says so instead of claiming success
steps.detail: the token-dead card rendered, and no withdrawal was claimed

steps.name: arriving with no token at all is a stated state, not a blank page

findings.summary: the browser leg runs against the fixture backend
findings.detail: The link, the token and the page are real; the endpoint behind them is the fixture. That the withdrawal SUPPRESSES the next campaign is proved against real code in WebApi.Tests/Growth/GrowthUnsubscribeExitReachabilityTests.
